inicio.titulo: The agentic company and the 2027 manager
inicio.lead: In 2026, companies learned to build agents. In 2027, the challenge is managing them alongside people and processes. In eight lessons you understand what changed in management, read the market without falling for showcase numbers, measure yourself against the 8 AI manager competencies, choose your career move and leave with the first process to manage.
inicio.capa_alt: A manager points to a board of colorful blocks in a quick team meeting; through the glass, the distributor's warehouse and a forklift.

cursos.sub: Suggested order: G0 → G2 → G3 → G4 → G1 → G5. G1 (people) can run in parallel, and if you work in HR you can start with it. Courses not yet published open as they become ready.

itens.rot: G0 · entry point · you are here
itens.t: The agentic company and the 2027 manager
itens.l: What changed in management, what the consultancies say, Brazil, your career and your first process.

itens.t: Processes: a process is not sacred
itens.l: Take the process apart before automating it: eliminate, simplify, redesign and decide who does each step.
Role, delegation, constitution, authority limits, progressive trust, agent team and exception queue.
Choose a model for each case, take care of context and company knowledge, and measure cost per result.
What stays with people, the conversation about change, the junior who supervises agents and team training.
Owners, permissions and records; evaluation with indicators; one LOOP-R cycle and the final project of the program.

inicio.aulas_sub: First, what changed and what it means to manage agents (lessons 1 to 4). Then the market, read with a critical eye: consulting firms, Brazil and career (lessons 5 to 7). Lesson 8 picks your first process and the next course.

itens: Area managers, owners of small or mid-sized businesses, and operations or HR leaders who have, or soon will have, AI agents working on their team.
People who don't code and don't want to: here you learn to manage. Building an agent is a different course.
People who get a report every month saying "AI will change everything" and want to know what is fact, what is forecast and what to do on Monday.

blocos.t: What you will be able to do
itens: Explain why management gained a third object and translate people management into agent management.
Put a named owner on each of the 9 management objects in your area and measure yourself on the 8 competencies.
Read a McKinsey, Deloitte, Microsoft or Gartner report, separating survey, self-reported experience and forecast.
Choose your career move, evaluate an outside certificate and pick your first process to manage with agents.

blocos.t: The case that runs through the program
itens: Horizonte Distribuidora, a 40-person fictional study company that distributes cleaning products in the interior of São Paulo.
You play Patrícia Lima, sales manager, who received Hora, an agent that sells over WhatsApp. The process is the order that arrives on WhatsApp and goes all the way to invoicing.
Every lesson has one practice at Horizonte, to train, and another at your own company or in your career, for real.
